senses.gloss: m. (part. pass. of כָּעַס) an excited serpent.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 62b:19">Sabb. 62ᵇ</cite> (play on <he>תעכסנה</he>, <cite ref="Isaiah 3:16">Is. III, 16</cite>) <he>ומכניסות … כארס בכ׳</he> they caused lust to seize their (the men’s) hearts (as hot as) as the venom of the excited serpent; (older eds. <he>כארס נחש כעוס</he>; Ms. O. <he>כא׳ של עכנה</he>, Ms. M. <he>כאש בנעורת</he>); <cite ref="Yoma 9b">Yoma 9ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 264">Yalk. Is. 264</cite>.—V. <cite ref="K00970"><he>כָּעַס</he></cite>.
